visual_objective.visual_objective: 曖昧な希望から似合う方向が見えてくる感覚を、提案力とスタイル選択の明快さで可視化する。
visual_objective.intended_first_impression: 洗練・親しみ・提案力・選びやすさ

color_direction.primary_color_direction: soft charcoal / taupe / neutral brown family
color_direction.accent_color_direction: muted rose-beige or soft metallic neutral
color_direction.background_direction: bright neutral with selective warm panels
evidence_or_reasoning: Existing exact brand colors are not yet structured, so avoid inventing a signature palette.
Creative Concept requires clarity and style comparison rather than condition-anxiety calmness.
Neutral base allows multiple style directions to remain visually primary.

typography_direction.heading_style: modern serif or refined geometric sans mix
typography_direction.emphasis_style: clear medium/bold sans for choice labels
legibility_constraints: avoid overly decorative type that weakens choice clarity

usage_constraints: official public image usage is NOT_CONFIRMED; final commercial production needs approved/licensed/generated alternatives

layout_density_direction.whitespace_direction: clean but more structured than girasol
layout_density_direction.hero_structure_direction: strong style visual plus concise uncertainty-to-clarity message
layout_density_direction.card_usage_direction: use for style/choice comparison and short proof points
layout_density_direction.full_bleed_usage_direction: selective; use for key style or consultation proof
layout_density_direction.section_variation_direction: alternate uncertainty, style options, fit logic, customer voice, proposal experience, diagnosis

cta_treatment_direction.sticky_cta_behavior_direction: compact persistent mobile CTA after hero; keep gallery content unobstructed
cta_treatment_direction.button_tone: neutral dark or brand-following accent with clear contrast

visual_proof_contract.minimum_proof_role: Customer must be able to imagine moving from a vague request to a clearer suitable style direction.
evidence_limitations: current public asset commercial reuse rights not confirmed
interior/facility specifics require recheck before claim use

genericness_check.notes: Direction is specific only if style comparison and fit/suggestion are visually central; neutral beauty styling alone would be generic.
